about: World Cube Association (speedcubing) public data: search competitions and fetch their results, scrambles, schedules (WCIF) and competitors; look up competitors' profiles, personal records and results; get current world, continental and national records and news posts. All of it comes from the WCA's public /api/v0 JSON API.

commands.summary: Search WCA competitions like the /competitions page: keyword, event, country and date filters, sorted and paginated with 25 per page

params.name: q
params.description: Keyword matched against competition name or city

params.name: event
params.description: Only competitions that hold this event (WCA event id)

params.name: country_iso2
params.description: Region filter as an ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 country code, e.g. ES, US

params.name: ongoing_and_future
params.description: ISO date, e.g. 2026-10-18. Only competitions ongoing or upcoming as of this date; the web UI sends today's date. Omit to include past competitions.

params.name: sort
params.description: Comma-separated sort keys; prefix a key with '-' for descending, e.g. -end_date

commands.summary: List competitions through the public API, filtered by country and a start/end date range, with sort and pagination

params.name: country_iso2
params.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 country code, e.g. ES

params.name: start
params.description: Only competitions on or after this ISO date, e.g. 2025-01-01

params.name: end
params.description: Only competitions on or before this ISO date, e.g. 2025-12-31

params.name: sort
params.description: Sort key; prefix with '-' for descending, e.g. -start_date

commands.summary: Get one competition's details: dates, venue, registration settings, fees and information
Get a competition's results for one event, round by round, with each competitor's position, best, average and attempts
Get the official scrambles a competition used for one event, grouped by round
Get a competition's public WCIF: events, rounds, formats, time limits, cutoffs, schedule/venues and registered persons with their assignments
List the people who competed in or are registered for a competition
Search WCA competitors by name or WCA id; each result includes competition count and personal records with ranks
Get a competitor's profile by WCA id: country, delegate status, teams, competition count and personal records (single/average with world, continent and country ranks)
List every result a competitor has, one row per round: competition, event, round, position, best, average, attempts
List the competitions a competitor has attended
Get current world, continental and national records (single and average) for every event
Site-wide search (the navbar omnisearch) that returns matching people and competitions
List WCA news and announcement posts, newest first, 10 per page

params.name: page
params.description: Page number, starting at 1; the response's totalPages gives the last page
